conversation.question: I am a mech E student in my third year first semester, when should I take the senior project?
conversation.actualAnswer:
For the Senior Research Project course VMED580, students must complete the prerequisite courses VMED425, VMED433, VMED435, VMED444, VMED448, and VMED451 with at least a minimum grade D before enrolling.

The senior project VMED580 is a prerequisite for the Year 5 clinical core rotations and internship courses, which are taken in Year 5 semesters 1 and 2 after completing all courses from years 1 to 4.

The senior project (VMED580) is listed in the program structure for the Bachelor of Veterinary Medicine as part of Cluster 5, typically taken before the fifth year internship.
